dataSources: Kafka Connect REST status (`kafkaconnect:status`), worker logs (`kafkaconnect:worker`), and JMX source/sink metrics (`kafkaconnect:jmx`). Collected via Universal Forwarder (Splunkbase 617) modular input or scripted poll into the index named in the SPL.
app: Kafka Connect REST API (`/connectors`, `/connectors/{name}/status`) via HEC scripted inputs; Connect worker logs and JMX metrics. — Universal Forwarder (Splunkbase 617)
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=kafkaconnect:status
| stats latest(connector_state) as conn_state, sum(eval(task_state="FAILED")) as failed_tasks, count as total_tasks by connector
| where failed_tasks>0 OR conn_state="FAILED"
| sort - failed_tasks
description: Identifies UC-24.8.14 — Kafka, Connect, Task, Failed, State — using `index=bi` sourcetype `kafkaconnect:status`, grouped by `connector`. Outputs `sum` each `the scheduled window`; alert when `failed_tasks` > 0. Primary focus: Failed State. Purpose-built for 'Kafka Connect Task Failed State' in Operations workflows.

detailedImplementation:
Step 1 — Configure data collection

Install and configure the add-on referenced in the app field (Kafka Connect REST API (`/connectors`, `/connectors/{name}/status`) via HEC scripted inputs; Connect worker logs and JMX metrics. — Universal Forwarder (Splunkbase 617)). Enable the modular input or HEC token that writes sourcetype=kafkaconnect:status into bi. Default poll interval 300–900 seconds unless the vendor API rate-limits lower. Grant the ingestion role `list_inputs` and `search` on the target index.

Step 2 — Create the search and alert

Schedule the SPL with earliest=-24h@h and throttle per entity to avoid duplicate pages. Document tunable macros in the comment header. Understanding this SPL: filters in the first pipeline reduce license cost; stats/timechart aggregates define the alert grain; joins/lookups enrich owner or asset metadata for routing.

Step 3 — Validate

Compare `| tstats count where index=... sourcetype=...` against the vendor admin UI inventory count (+/-5%). Spot-check two known entities for field presence (`connector, failed_tasks`). Run `timechart count span=1h` over 7 days to find ingestion gaps longer than two poll intervals.

Step 4 — Operationalize

Add a dashboard row with single-value KPI tiles, a 24-hour timechart, and a drilldown table mirroring the SPL output columns. Route critical severity to the platform on-call channel; route warning to the service owner from the lookup.

Step 5 — Troubleshooting

No events: verify forwarder connectivity, HEC token ACLs, and that the modular input appears in `index=_internal source=*splunkd*`. NULL fields: check props/transforms order and TA version. Fewer results than expected: confirm index allow-lists on the search head role and that `_time` uses the correct timezone. API errors: inspect splunkd.log for HTTP 401/429 from the vendor endpoint configured in inputs.conf.
grandmaExplanation: We watch the streaming data connectors and flag any part that has failed, since it will stay stopped until someone restarts it.
